question: List every agency's id with the name of its parent agency, if it has one.
reply:
```sql
SELECT 
    a.agency_id, 
    p.name AS parent_agency_name 
FROM 
    org.agency AS a 
LEFT JOIN 
    org.agency AS p ON a.parent_agency_id = p.agency_id;
```
